acceptance_criteria.description: The runner must validate policies/checks.json against verification/schemas/checks.schema.json prior to executing any check.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: registry.load() verifies schema and returns check list; policy hash matches independent hashlib.sha256

acceptance_criteria.description: The registry validator must reject malformed JSON, missing files, empty registries, duplicate id values, non-array argv, empty argv, non-positive timeouts, and invalid data types.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts with exit code 2; stderr pinpoints invalid key or syntax error

acceptance_criteria.description: If registry validation fails, the runner must immediately terminate with exit code 2 (Harness Error), emitting actionable schema validation errors to stderr.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Exit code is 2; stderr contains actionable diagnostic message

acceptance_criteria.description: At least one mandatory check must exist in the registry. An all-optional registry must be rejected with exit code 2.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts with exit code 2; stderr contains 'Registry contains zero required checks'

acceptance_criteria.description: A candidate verification run must execute all enabled required checks present in the active policy registry.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: All required checks are dispatched and recorded in candidate execution

acceptance_criteria.description: A failure in an optional check must be recorded with status FAIL in evidence report but must not cause overall candidate run verdict to fail, provided required checks pass.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Overall exit code 0 and verdict PASS while optional check records status FAIL and exit_code 1

acceptance_criteria.description: A failure in any required check must cause the overall candidate run verdict to be FAIL and exit with code 1.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Overall exit code 1; overall verdict FAIL

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing, unknown, or invalid check selections requested via CLI must fail closed immediately with exit code 2.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts with exit code 2; stderr contains 'Unknown check ID'

acceptance_criteria.description: Required check identity, applicability, and completeness must be validated. Candidate execution cannot omit, rename, or downgrade required checks.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Evidence validator flags missing required check and sets overall verdict to FAIL

acceptance_criteria.description: Candidate Lane mandates verified clean git checkout before run, executes all required checks, verifies clean post-run, computes digests, and generates candidate report.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts on dirty worktree; executes and generates report with lane candidate on clean worktree

acceptance_criteria.description: Fast Local Lane is permitted to run against a dirty working tree, accepts --check to run a single targeted check, and produces a report flagged with lane fast.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Report contains 'lane': 'fast' and succeeds on dirty worktree

acceptance_criteria.description: Any report generated with lane fast is strictly invalid as evidence for Gate G4 or candidate PR evaluation.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Auditor fails with message 'Fast lane report cannot be used for candidate gate evaluation'

acceptance_criteria.description: In Candidate Lane, the runner must strictly execute against the approved canonical policy path (policies/checks.json). Alternate --config paths must match canonical digest or be rejected.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts with exit code 2 and 'Alternate configuration not approved for candidate lane'

acceptance_criteria.description: Targeted check execution via --check is strictly prohibited in Candidate Lane and must abort immediately with exit code 2.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts with exit code 2 and 'Partial check execution is prohibited in candidate lane'

acceptance_criteria.description: Commands must be executed strictly by passing argv directly to subprocess.Popen/subprocess.run with shell=False.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Subprocess executes directly without shell interpreter wrapper

acceptance_criteria.description: The runner must capture both standard output and standard error into a unified sequential byte stream without buffer deadlocks.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: 5MB output stream captured completely without hang; length matches byte-for-byte

acceptance_criteria.description: The exact integer exit code returned by the child process must be recorded in check result structure separately from synthetic runner status.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: CheckResult records exit_code: 1 and status: 'FAIL'

acceptance_criteria.description: If target binary cannot be found or executed, the runner must record status ERROR and exit code 127.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Exit code 127; check status ERROR; stderr captures '[EXECUTABLE NOT FOUND]'

acceptance_criteria.description: Subprocess creation errors (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, OSError) must be handled within explicit exception boundaries, preserving OS error codes (127, 126).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: PermissionError caught; records status ERROR and exit code 126 with '[PERMISSION DENIED]'

acceptance_criteria.description: Each check must execute within its configured timeout_seconds.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Execution terminates within configured timeout + grace period

acceptance_criteria.description: On Linux/POSIX systems, the child process must be spawned in its own process group with pgid = proc.pid captured immediately at spawn time.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Runner tracks pgid and issues process group signals via os.killpg

acceptance_criteria.description: Timeout cleanup must not depend solely on parent process remaining alive. Inspect remaining processes in pgid, send SIGTERM, wait 0.5s grace, and escalate to SIGKILL.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: SIGTERM-resistant child process reaped via SIGKILL escalation

acceptance_criteria.description: Total cleanup duration must be bounded (max 2.0s). If descendant processes cannot be terminated, runner explicitly records cleanup_failed: true.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Elapsed cleanup duration bounded < 4.0s total elapsed time

acceptance_criteria.description: All partial output captured prior to timeout or termination must be preserved in the log capture.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Partial log output emitted before timeout is retained in CheckResult.output

acceptance_criteria.description: A timed-out check must be recorded with status TIMEOUT, exit code 124, and block the candidate gate.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: CheckResult records status TIMEOUT and exit code 124; overall verdict FAIL

acceptance_criteria.description: Prior to executing checks, candidate lane runs git status --porcelain; aborts with exit code 2 if dirty or assume-unchanged/skip-worktree bits are set.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Aborts immediately prior to running checks; exit code 2; stderr contains 'Working tree is not clean'

acceptance_criteria.description: Following check execution, candidate lane re-runs git status; aborts with exit code 2 if working tree mutated (excluding artifacts/verification/).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Detects mutated file; exits with code 2 and report verdict ERROR

acceptance_criteria.description: For each run, the runner must generate a unique UUIDv4 run_id and write artifacts/verification/<run_id>/report.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: UUIDv4 format verified; report file exists at expected path

acceptance_criteria.description: report.json must record schema_version, run_id, tested_sha, base_sha, policy_sha256, policy_modified_from_base, lane, timestamps, environment, verdict, and checks list.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Validates report.json against report.schema.json

acceptance_criteria.description: Complete combined output of each check must be written to <check_id>.log with its SHA-256 digest recorded in report.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Log file hash computed independently matches log_sha256 bit-for-bit

acceptance_criteria.description: The validator must verify that report.json conforms structurally to verification/schemas/report.schema.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Rejects malformed report missing required keys with schema validation error

acceptance_criteria.description: The validator must reject reports where tested_sha does not match active candidate HEAD SHA or base_sha does not match expected target base.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Rejects report with 'Report tested_sha mismatch'

acceptance_criteria.description: The validator must reject reports where policy_sha256 does not match active checks.json hash or unauthorized policy modification.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Rejects report with 'Policy hash mismatch'

acceptance_criteria.description: The validator must verify that every log file referenced in the report exists on disk and its SHA-256 matches log_sha256.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Detects tampered byte with 'Log integrity violation'

acceptance_criteria.description: Reusing report artifacts from a prior commit or another branch must be strictly rejected.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Rejects stale commit reports against current commit HEAD SHA

acceptance_criteria.description: The evidence validator must independently recompute overall run verdict from actual required check results and exit codes, rejecting forged PASS verdicts.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Recomputed verdict detects discrepancy; rejects with 'Forged PASS verdict rejected'

acceptance_criteria.description: The evidence validator must reject reports containing inconsistent result status and exit code.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Rejects report with 'Inconsistent check status and exit code'

acceptance_criteria.description: Four-tier governance distinction: local execution result, evidence validation result, governance authorization, and remote CI status. A valid local report is not merge authorization.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Fast lane report rejected for candidate evaluation; authorization requires independent human sign-off

acceptance_criteria.description: Initial verification policy is generated as a proposal in policies/bootstrap_proposal.json with status PROPOSED and authorized_by: null. Authoritative candidate evidence acceptance requires an externally established expected SHA, base revision, policy digest, and required-check set provided via CLI flags.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Auditor rejects report when expected policy digest does not match external context

acceptance_criteria.description: If any required check from policies/checks.json is missing from results list, overall verdict must be FAIL.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Auditor fails with 'Missing result for required check: <id>'

acceptance_criteria.description: Duplicate check IDs in results must cause the report to be rejected with exit code 2.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Auditor fails with 'Duplicate check ID in report: <id>'

acceptance_criteria.description: Required checks that yield SKIP, ERROR, NOT_RUN, or TIMEOUT must cause overall verdict to be FAIL while retaining exact individual status.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Status preserved without false PASS conversion; overall verdict is FAIL

acceptance_criteria.description: For checks designated as test suites (type: test_suite), check execution must directly invoke structured test runner adapter (test_adapter.py) rather than relying on console scraping.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Structured adapter executes tests via unittest.TestRunner capturing exact counts

acceptance_criteria.description: Test summary must capture total, passed, failures, errors, skipped, and fail if total == 0 (ZERO_TESTS_DISCOVERED).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: total == 0 yields status FAIL and diagnostic 'Zero tests discovered'

acceptance_criteria.description: Required skipped tests (skipped > 0 where disallowed) must block the gate.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: skipped > 0 yields status FAIL and diagnostic 'Disallowed skipped tests'

acceptance_criteria.description: Reports with missing, malformed, or inconsistent test execution metrics relative to exit codes must fail closed and block the gate.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Malformed test summary raises ValueError and records status ERROR

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifies that all requirement IDs in specs/changes/ are unique and referenced in traceability.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Untraced requirement detected; validator exits with code 1

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifies that all Markdown hyperlinks and image references resolve to existing files or anchors, filtering out external web schemes.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Broken relative link detected; validator exits with code 1

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifies that 100% of MUST acceptance criteria in active change specification map to a planned task, check ID, and validation test oracle.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Validator asserts planned_mapping_coverage == 100.0

acceptance_criteria.description: The runner must record SHA-256 digest of checks.json before and after execution; modification during run fails checkout cleanliness.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Post-run check detects modified policy file; runner exits with code 2

acceptance_criteria.description: Changes to policies/ or verification/ must be flagged as T4 risk assets in review workflows.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: check_policy_modified_from_base returns True when policies/ modified

acceptance_criteria.description: Selftests must execute against temporary directories initialized as synthetic Git repositories with an initial empty commit.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: setUp initializes ephemeral git repository with user.name and user.email

acceptance_criteria.description: Selftests must never invoke the entire verification harness recursively against the root repository.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Selftests execute checks against synthetic fixture directories only

acceptance_criteria.description: Selftests must verify negative failure paths: intentional command failure, process timeout, missing binary, dirty repo abort, post-run mutation, and malformed registry.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: All negative selftest assertions check exact non-zero exit codes and error substrings

acceptance_criteria.description: Injects synthetic defect into a mock report (tampered log hash) and proves evidence validator catches it.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: verify_log_hash returns False when content mutated

acceptance_criteria.description: Injects synthetic broken link into mock spec and proves spec validator catches it.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: validate_markdown_text returns non-empty error list identifying broken link

acceptance_criteria.description: Injects untracked file into mock git repo and proves cleanliness guard catches it.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: is_clean_checkout returns False and identifies untracked file

acceptance_criteria.description: Workflow must declare minimal permissions structurally validated via YAML parser: permissions: { contents: read }. Local validation records STATIC_VALIDATED; remote execution remains NOT_EXECUTED_REMOTELY until GitHub Actions run.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: PyYAML parser asserts permissions.contents == 'read' and zero write permissions

acceptance_criteria.description: Workflow executes on pull_request and push to main with concurrency cancellation.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: YAML parser asserts triggers include pull_request and push to main

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifies candidate SHA matches PR head SHA or push SHA, runs python3 verification/run.py --lane candidate, and archives artifacts/verification/ as build artifacts.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: YAML parser verifies candidate SHA ref, --lane candidate argument, and upload-artifact action

acceptance_criteria.description: Contains zero production secrets, AWS tokens, or signing keys.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Audit confirms zero secrets or tokens in workflow YAML

acceptance_criteria.description: Defect records must be stored in verification/defects.jsonl adhering to schema verification/schemas/defects.schema.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: validate_defects_registry returns ok == True with 0 errors

acceptance_criteria.description: Anti-pattern rules must be stored in verification/antipatterns.json adhering to schema verification/schemas/antipatterns.schema.json.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: validate_antipattern_registry returns ok == True with 0 errors

acceptance_criteria.description: Anti-pattern rules categorized by lifecycle state (PROPOSED, ADVISORY, APPROVED_ACTIVE). Only APPROVED_ACTIVE rules with dual samples and false-positive proof execute as blocking gates.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Evaluates positive match and negative non-match for each rule

acceptance_criteria.description: Every defect record must be categorized as HISTORICAL_RE_DEFECT (historical RE reference discrepancies, not application defects or licensing violation claims), PROPOSED_PREVENTIVE_CHECK, or CONFIRMED_APPLICATION_DEFECT. Unexecuted RED/GREEN evidence fields must be null until executed.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: Validates classification enum and asserts unexecuted pre_fix_red_result and post_fix_green_result are null
